description: Developed detailed operations plans and operations orders supporting cyber requirements at the strategic, operational, and tactical levels of cyber warfare.
Enabled crisis action planning, development of strike packages and cyber effects to protect U.S. air, land, sea, space, and cyberspace domains.
Collaborated with Defense Information Systems Agency and other US Government partners to develop and implement directives for Global Information Grid (GIG) operations.

Technical lead on digital media projects, guided teams to solutions that leveraged technical capabilities. Defined requirements for computer-based systems that supported electronic publishing Air Force wide.
Ensured documentation of requirements for systems administration and information tasking orders.
Served as technical lead on electronic publishing development and integration teams. Ensured all development was consistent with Air Force guidance.
Managed computer support, cost analysis, and acquisition to support ANG work plans.
Led teams to execute Air National Guard budget for computers and associated technologies.

matchmaking_summary: The candidate presents a robust profile in the field of Information Technology and Cyber security, demonstrating significant expertise in both managerial and technical aspects. With over two decades of experience in various roles within the Air Force and as an IT specialist, the candidate has cultivated a comprehensive understanding of INFOSEC/NETOPS techniques, SCADA systems operations, and security tools necessary for protecting information technology infrastructure across diverse domains. Their professional journey includes notable accomplishments such as developing detailed operation plans and policies to safeguard U.S. air, land, sea, space, and cyberspace domains, which underscores their dedication to safeguarding critical national assets.
